info.title: WallStreetBets 2022
info.subtitle: Collected posts and comments from WallStreetBets subreddit (2022)
info.description:
## Content

Posts and comments are collected from the r/wallstreetbets subreddit.

## Data source and collection

Data source is: https://www.reddit.com/r/wallstreetbets/  
Data collected using praw Python package  
Data is collected and merged daily

## Acknowledgments

The data content is created by the Reddit contributors in this subrrddit. 

## Inspiration


Use this data to understand the trends initiated by Reddit educated crowd. Perform sentiment analysis for the posts and comments of this dataset. Extract the topics (using topic modelling) in the posts and comments.
